authorInfo.bio: Susan Anne Ridley Sedgwick (1788–1867) was a 19th-century American writer specializing in children's novels. She also painted a watercolor-on-ivory portrait of an ex-slave who came to work for her family.

description: "The Young Emigrants; Madelaine Tube; The Boy and the Book; and The Crystal Palace" is a children’s book written in the mid-19th century. This collection follows various characters, including the Lee family as they embark on their journey as emigrants to America, highlighting themes of hope, perseverance, and the challenges faced by those seeking a better life in a new land.
